The lesson explains how CSC personnel work supports skills-based selection, training, service standards and accountability. It develops qualifications with evidence, coverage through corporate creation, merit and examination exceptions, lawful-cause protection, campaign limits, and independence through funding and conflict safeguards. Examples apply each group of concepts.

Checked limitations: citizenship election exception; age at appointment; candidacy tied to the immediately preceding election; no single required degree or job; first staggered terms and unexpired vacancy term; no acting or temporary member; original-charter condition; as-far-as-practicable examination rule and three exceptions preserving merit; lawful discipline and voting distinguished from campaigning; salary and outside-work restrictions tied to tenure; affected-business and direct/indirect financial-interest scope.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: A **natural-born citizen** is a Philippine citizen from birth who needs no act to acquire or complete that citizenship.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: The lesson defines natural-born citizenship and separately explains the constitutional exception.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: This means it leads the system for managing government workers.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: The personnel-agency role is explained and developed through merit, training and service duties.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: The first appointees under the Constitution had staggered terms: $7$ years for the Chairman, $5$ for one Commissioner, and $3$ for the other.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: Initial staggered terms are given. The next paragraph also limits replacements to the unexpired term.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: No member may be appointed or designated in a temporary or acting capacity.
lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.note: Both temporary and acting appointments or designations are expressly barred.

lesson-philippine-constitution-the-civil.quote: Article IX-B of the $1987$ Constitution covers the **Civil Service Commission**, or CSC.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: The CSC builds the **career service**, where people can develop a lasting government career based on their skills and work.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The Article IX-B location, personnel role and skills-based career service are now developed.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Lina was a Philippine citizen from birth through her Filipino father. She needed no later act to acquire or complete her citizenship.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: A definition and two citizenship examples now apply the natural-born qualification.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A record of managing public staff, services, and resources can help show this ability.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson explains administrative ability and applies management evidence without inventing a sole legal test.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Appointments must be based on **merit and fitness**.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The following definitions and hiring example explain qualifications, suitability and why friendship is insufficient.

general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Training and greater duties explain career development, with application in example 9.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Coverage also includes government-owned or controlled corporations with **original charters**.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A civil service officer or employee may be removed or suspended only for a cause provided by law.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The rule and lawful-discipline limit are taught, then applied to a suspension for personal dislike.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Civil service officers and employees may not take part, directly or indirectly, in electioneering or a partisan political campaign.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Its approved annual funding must be released automatically and regularly.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: During their tenure, members cannot hold another office or job.
